purpose: Audited provenance and adoption boundaries for the agent nursery, evaluation, document-routing, intelligence-sweep, defensive-OSINT and telemetry patterns proposed for AI Factory.

sources.license: Sustainable Use License with enterprise-only portions
sources.factoryRole: agent nursery orchestration, triggers, approvals and long-running workflow coordination
trace sink, experiment/evaluation surface and fitness evidence provider
mustNot: become the source of Factory policy
promote an agent without Factory gates
turn evaluator output into MEASURED evidence unless the metric provenance is present

sources.factoryRole: PDF preflight and extraction routing before OCR/vision
mustNot: treat classification confidence as document truth
use OCR when native extraction is sufficient without a reason

sources.factoryRole: parallel multi-source sweep, source-health and temporal-delta pattern for intelligence monitoring
mustNot: copy AGPL implementation into Factory core without an explicit license decision
promote a single-source alert as confirmed fact

sources.factoryRole: defensive OSINT identity discovery pattern across public services
mustNot: be enabled as unrestricted people-search in the general research toolbelt
be used for stalking, credential discovery or intrusive targeting
be vendored until license and intended-use review are complete
expose a local hardware telemetry endpoint to the public Internet by default
treat a dashboard visualization as the telemetry source of truth
vendor code until license review is complete
